arguments.command:
@'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/testing.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/testing.py'])
current = p.read_bytes()
print('Original CRLF:', original.count(b'\r\n'), 'LF:', original.count(b'\n'))
old_lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
new_lines = current.splitlines(keepends=True)
import difflib
for tag, i, j, a, b in reversed(list(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in old_lines], [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in new_lines]).get_opcodes())):
    if tag == 'equal':
        new_lines[a:b] = old_lines[i:j]
p.write_bytes(b''.join(new_lines))
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager status --short
